summary: GRI 13 gives organizations in crop production, animal production, aquaculture and fishing information on their likely material topics, such as emissions, biodiversity, soil, pesticides, food safety, animal welfare, labor and land rights. It lists disclosures to report for each topic.

questions.text: Aquaculture production: for each species of aquatic organisms produced, what are the scientific name, volume, farming methods and production site, and what are the details of wild-caught juvenile seed stock and fishing products used in feed?

Wild-caught juvenile seed stock: name, volume, fishing methods, origin, stock status. c. Fishing products in feed: species, whole fish or waste, origin, stock status.
